create_flask_app: create a Flask application with SocketIO for docstring generation visualization
test_llm_api: test the LLM API connection with Claude or OpenAI using an API key
start_docstring_generation: start the docstring generation process for a given repository path and config
stop_docstring_generation: stop the running docstring generation process
get_completeness_data: get the current completeness evaluation of docstrings in a repository
